flow.description: Flow (NetFlow v5/v9 + IPFIX + sFlow v5) receiver configuration.

raw_capture.description:
Common raw-payload capture default, inherited by every transport that
supports capture. Per-transport `raw_capture:` blocks override it
field by field. See [`raw_capture`].

scaling.description: Scaling pressure configuration for KEDA autoscaling.

config_reload_secs.description: Periodic config reload interval in seconds (0 = disabled, SIGHUP only).

file_sink.description: Debug file sink — writes all processed messages to a file.

max_body_size.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

max_concurrent_requests.description:
Maximum concurrent in-flight requests (0 = unlimited).
Protects against connection exhaustion and memory pressure.

RateLimitConfig.description: Per-IP rate limiting configuration using GCRA (token bucket variant).

requests_per_second.description: Maximum sustained requests per second per source IP.

burst.description: Burst capacity above the sustained rate.

cert_file.description: Path to certificate file (local file path).

key_file.description: Path to private key file (local file path).

ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate for client verification (mTLS).

cert_secret.description:
Secret source for certificate (overrides cert_file).
Format: "provider:path:key" (e.g., "vault:secret/tls:cert")

key_secret.description:
Secret source for private key (overrides key_file).
Format: "provider:path:key" (e.g., "vault:secret/tls:key")

ca_secret.description:
Secret source for CA certificate (overrides ca_file).
Format: "provider:path:key" (e.g., "vault:secret/tls:ca")

refresh_interval_secs.description:
Refresh interval for secrets in seconds.
Default: 3600 (1 hour)

mode.description: Auth mode (none, header, bearer, mtls, both).

accepted_headers.description:
List of accepted headers (any one must match).
Each entry defines a header name and its allowed values.

include_common_header.description:
Include the common `x-hyperi-agent` header in accepted headers.
Also gates source rule evaluation and timestamp enrichment.
Default: true

header_name.description:
Legacy: Single header name for header-based auth.
Deprecated: Use `accepted_headers` instead.

header_values.description:
Legacy: Allowed header values for single header.
Deprecated: Use `accepted_headers` instead.

values.description:
Allowed values for this header.
If empty, any non-empty value is accepted.

tokens.description:
Static tokens (for dev/simple deployments).
In production, use `secret_source` instead.

secret_source.description:
Secret source for dynamic token loading.
Format: "provider:path:key" (e.g., "vault:secret/auth:bearer_tokens")

refresh_interval_secs.description:
Token refresh interval in seconds (for secret-sourced tokens).
Default: 300 (5 minutes)

grpc_bind_address.description: Bind address for OTLP gRPC (standard port 4317).

http_bind_address.description: Bind address for OTLP HTTP (standard port 4318).

mode.description:
Conversion mode: "hyperdx" (default) or "generic".

- `hyperdx`: JSON matching the OTel ClickHouse exporter schema
  for direct HyperDX compatibility.
- `generic`: Normalised JSON envelope with routing fields.

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

OTLP arrives as protobuf, so `_raw` carries the `generic`-mode
rendering of the record -- the least-shaped decode we produce. In
`generic` mode it is therefore a copy of the event itself.

RawCaptureConfig.description:
Raw-capture settings as written in config, at either cascade level.

Every field is `Option` so an unset field means "inherit", not "off".

OversizePolicy.description: What to do with a payload larger than `max_bytes`.

oneOf.description: Keep the leading `max_bytes` and flag it with `_raw_truncated: true`.
Emit no `_raw` at all for this event.

LumberjackConfig.description:
Lumberjack v2 (Beats) protocol configuration.

Accepts data from Elastic Beats agents (Filebeat, Winlogbeat, etc.)
over the Lumberjack v2 wire protocol on TCP/TLS.

bind_address.description: Bind address for Lumberjack TCP listener (standard port 5044).

tls.description: TLS configuration (Beats clients typically require TLS).

SplunkHecConfig.description:
Splunk HEC (HTTP Event Collector) receiver configuration.

Accepts data from Splunk forwarders and HTTP clients over the HEC protocol.
Supports both `Authorization: Splunk <token>` and `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

bind_address.description: Bind address for Splunk HEC HTTP listener (standard port 8088).

max_body_size.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

On `/services/collector/event`, `_raw` carries the submitted `event`
value before HEC metadata is merged in. On `/services/collector/raw`
it carries the original line bytes.

SyslogConfig.description:
Syslog receiver configuration (RFC 5424 + RFC 3164).

Accepts syslog messages over UDP, TCP, and TLS/TCP.
Auto-detects message format (RFC 5424 vs RFC 3164) per message.

udp_bind_address.description: Bind address for UDP listener (standard port 514).

tcp_bind_address.description: Bind address for TCP listener (standard port 514).

tls_bind_address.description: Bind address for TLS/TCP listener (standard port 6514, RFC 5425).

max_message_size.description: Maximum syslog message size in bytes.

tls.description: TLS configuration (for secure syslog on port 6514).

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

The strongest case for capture: `_raw` holds the wire line including
the PRI and header, none of which survives into the parsed envelope.

mode.description:
Output mode: "native" (default), "otel", or "hyperdx".
- `native`: Flat JSON with labels as top-level fields.
- `otel`: Generic OTel JSON envelope (snake_case, RFC 3339).
- `hyperdx`: HyperDX ClickHouse-compatible JSON (PascalCase, DateTime64).

max_body_size.description: Maximum request body size in bytes.

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

Remote Write arrives as snappy-framed protobuf, so `_raw` carries the
`native`-mode rendering of the sample -- the least-shaped decode we
produce. In `native` mode it is therefore a copy of the event itself.

FluentConfig.description:
Fluent Forward protocol configuration.

Accepts data from Fluentd and Fluent Bit agents over the Forward
protocol (msgpack over TCP) on the standard port 24224.

bind_address.description: Bind address for TCP listener (standard port 24224).

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

Forward arrives as msgpack, so `_raw` carries the record's verbatim
msgpack-to-JSON decode, before the tag, timestamp and `_source` this
handler adds.

GelfConfig.description:
GELF (Graylog Extended Log Format) receiver configuration.

Accepts GELF messages over TCP (null-byte delimited JSON)
on the standard port 12201.

bind_address.description: Bind address for TCP listener (standard port 12201).

raw_capture.description:
Raw-payload capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

`_raw` holds the GELF message exactly as it arrived, before the
`message`, `severity` and `_source` fields this handler derives.

FlowConfig.description:
Unified-mode listener config -- one block applies to all decoders on
configured ports.

split.description: If present, switches to split mode and `flow.enabled` MUST be false.

experimental.description:
EXPERIMENTAL marker. When true (default), the handler emits a startup
WARN log and sets `dfe_handler_experimental{handler="flow"} 1`.
Flipped to false in a follow-up PR after stability period.

raw_capture.description:
Raw-record capture override (inherits the common `raw_capture` block).

`_raw` carries the decoder's verbatim record rendering: a JSON array
of every record in `canonical` mode, the single record in `exploded`.

OutputMode.description:
Shape of the emitted event: one per packet, or one per flow record.

Raw record retention is no longer a mode. It is
`flow.raw_capture.enabled`, which composes with either shape and writes
the common-header `_raw` field like every other transport.

dlq_on_invalid.description: Send invalid messages to DLQ instead of rejecting.

source_rules.description:
Rules for determining `_source` value (first match wins).
Only evaluated when `include_common_header` is true.

default_source.description: Default source when no rule matches.

topic_suffix.description: Suffix appended to source to form topic name.

legacy_compat.description:
Enable pre-2.2 compatibility.
Appends `key_value_use` rules for `tags.event.category` and `event_category`.

SourceRule.description: Rule for determining `_source` value from JSON payload.

field.description: JSON field path (dot notation for nested, e.g., "tags.event.category").

mode.description:
Match mode: "key_present", "key_value_set", "key_value_use".

- `key_present`: if field exists → `_source = source`
- `key_value_set`: if field value == `match_value` → `_source = source`
- `key_value_use`: if field exists → `_source = <field value>`

match_value.description: Value to match against (for `key_value_set` mode only).

source.description:
Source value to set (for `key_present` and `key_value_set` modes).
Ignored for `key_value_use` (uses the field value directly).

mode.description: Backend mode: cascade (default), fan_out, file_only, kafka_only.

topic.description:
DLQ topic name: when non-empty, every Kafka DLQ write routes here
(routing=common). Empty selects per-destination `{dest}{topic_suffix}`
routing -- reachable via config file only (flat-env drops empty values).

DestinationsConfig.description:
The named destination set: where a matched record goes.

`kafka` and `loader` are always available without being declared -- the bus
(the record's own topic) and the app named by the `loader` block. Any other
name is declared here as a sibling key, so a match rule can send a record to
a transform's Push listener, or fan it out to several destinations at once:

```yaml
destinations:
  default: loader
  rules:
    - match_field: app
      match_value: orders
      destination: [transform-orders, archiver]
  transform-orders:
    grpc:
      endpoint: "http://dfe-transform-orders:6000"
  archiver:
    grpc:
      endpoint: "http://dfe-archiver:6000"
```

default.description: Destination for records no rule matches.

rules.description: Routing rules for destination selection (first match wins).

DestinationRef.description:
One destination name, or a list of them to fan a matched record out to.

A fan-out is delivered when every destination has accepted it.

anyOf.description: Several destination names -- the record goes to all of them.

destination.description: Destination for matched messages: one name, or a list to fan out.

DestinationSpec.description: A declared destination: exactly one transport block.

grpc.description:
Deliver over gRPC to a scalo Push listener (a transform, the loader, the
archiver).

GrpcDestination.description: A gRPC destination -- the address of a scalo Push listener.

topic.description:
Fixed topic for this destination. Unset means the topic the record's
source resolves to, which is what the built-in `kafka` destination does.

compression.description: Compression type (none, gzip, snappy, lz4, zstd).

address.description:
Loader address, the manifest's `endpoints.push` port (apps.yaml).
Override with grpc_endpoint to dial a different URI.

transport.description: Transport type (kafka, grpc; `memory` discards and is refused at startup).

timeout_ms.description: Per-RPC deadline for the gRPC loader client, in milliseconds (0 = none).

grpc_endpoint.description:
gRPC endpoint URI for loader (only used when transport = "grpc").
Defaults to http://{address} if not set.

BufferConfig.description:
Buffer and memory configuration.

## Design Decision: No Disk Spillover

Memory-only buffering is used because:
1. K8s memory limits trigger OOMKill, which triggers KEDA scale-up
2. Vector clients have their own disk buffers for retries
3. Circuit breaker + 503 responses propagate backpressure upstream
4. Disk I/O would bottleneck the hot path at PB/s scale

memory_limit.description: Maximum memory for buffers in bytes (0 = auto-detect 67% of available).

pressure_threshold.description:
Memory pressure threshold (0.0-1.0).
When usage exceeds this, backpressure is applied (503 responses).

spillover.description:
Optional disk spillover configuration.
When enabled, messages are spilled to disk via scalo's TieredSink
when the primary sink is unavailable (instead of in-memory only).

SpilloverConfig.description:
Disk spillover configuration (opt-in, default disabled).

When enabled, failed sends are spilled to disk via scalo's TieredSink
instead of being held in an in-memory queue. This provides crash-resilient
buffering at the cost of disk I/O on the failure path.

max_usage_percent.description: Maximum filesystem usage percentage (0.0-1.0) before pausing spool writes.

poll_interval_secs.description: How often to check disk usage, in seconds.

ScalingConfig.description:
Scaling pressure configuration for KEDA autoscaling.

Configures the weighted composite metric that KEDA uses to scale the receiver.
Each component has a weight (relative importance) and saturation point (value
at which it contributes its full weight to the composite).

memory_gate_threshold.description: Memory usage ratio that triggers the memory gate (0.0-1.0).

enabled.description: Enable writing all processed messages to a file.

path.description: Path to the output file (NDJSON format, appended).
